was: Stutsman County park campground on the east shore of Jamestown Reservoir (Bureau of Reclamation dam), ~2 mi N of Jamestown. 48 gravel W/E sites (20/30 amp), max ~40 ft, dump station, showers, swimming beach, boat ramp, marina, fish-cleaning station. note: Stutsman County campground by Jamestown Reservoir, a Bureau of Reclamation lake, 2 miles north of Jamestown on Highway 20, with gravel sites for rigs up to 40 feet, four sleeping cabins, a swimming beach, fishing piers, boat ramps, a marina and a fish-cleaning station.  An island near the campground is open for day use. --Claude

was: On the Hell Creek arm of Fort Peck Lake, ~25 mi N of Jordan. 71 sites (44 electric), comfort station, potable water, RV dump station, fish-cleaning station, boat launch, private marina. Reservable (Campspot). Former MT State Park; the site (on USACE land) was transferred from MT FWP to the Little Shell Tribe of Chippewa Indians ~2021-22 and is now tribally operated as a public rec area. --Claude
note: Former Hell Creek State Park, on Corps of Engineers land on the Hell Creek arm of Fort Peck Lake, about 25 miles north of Jordan.  The state handed its lease to the Little Shell Tribe of Chippewa Indians, which has run it since about 2022.  Of the 71 sites, 44 have electric hookups; there is also a comfort station, a fish-cleaning station, a boat launch, a playground and trails, and a private marina sells bait, groceries and gas. --Claude

was: Gallatin County Fairgrounds RV camping in Bozeman; open year-round (no water Oct 1-May 1). 50-amp electric sites ($45) plus dry-camping sites ($20); water fill station, no sewer, 14-night max per 30 days. Reserve/pay in advance online. --Claude
note: Gallatin County Fairgrounds RV parking in Bozeman, home of the Big Sky Country State Fair.  Water is filled at the fairgrounds office for $5 on weekdays, tents aren't allowed, and stays are limited to 14 nights in any 30 days. --Claude

season.note: No RV reservations during the fair, July 5 to 30 in 2027.

was: Privately-operated campground and marina in the Silos Recreation Area on the shore of Canyon Ferry Lake, ~7 mi north of Townsend off US-287 (82 Silos Road). 86 dry sites across five loops (Falcon, Golden Eagle, Hawk, Osprey, Peregrine) — no hookups, water spigot for tank fill; marina with ~81 boat slips and multiple boat ramps. season.note: In the winter season, October 15 to April 15, there is no water or trash pickup, and the outhouses are cleaned weekly.
